assertion_results.text: Data extraction identifies the ecosystem as RPM based on the library name (openssl-libs) and component context, not Cargo (Step 1 Ecosystem detection — read ecosystems from Ecosystem Mappings config)
assertion_results.evidence: data-extraction.md 'Ecosystem detection' table: 'Ecosystem | **RPM** (system package in container image)', 'Lock file configured | Yes — `rpms.lock.yaml` (Ecosystem Mappings, both streams)'; extracted data lists 'Vulnerable library | openssl-libs (RPM, openssl)' and component 'pscomponent:org/rhtpa-server'. Cargo is not mentioned.

assertion_results.text: Version impact table includes ALL versions from the 2.2.x stream supportability matrix (2.2.0 through 2.2.4) and uses rpms.lock.yaml data for version extraction (Step 2.3)
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md 'In-scope stream: 2.2.x' table has rows 2.2.0, 2.2.1, 2.2.2, 2.2.3, 2.2.4 with column 'openssl-libs (rpms.lock.yaml)' (e.g. 2.2.0 3.0.7-25.el9_3, 2.2.3 3.0.7-28.el9_4); data source stated as 'git show <tag>:rpms.lock.yaml | grep 'openssl-libs''. 2.2.2 carried forward as retag of 2.2.1.

assertion_results.text: Dependency chain context identifies openssl-libs as present in rpms.lock.yaml and uses this to determine the package origin — the lock file presence is the primary classification signal (Step 2.3.5)
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md 2.3.5: 'rpms.lock.yaml: present → explicit install' and 'Using rpms.lock.yaml classification only'; 'Origin: explicit install (openssl-libs resolved in rpms.lock.yaml ...)'. remediation.md: 'Package origin (Step 2.3.5): **explicit install** (present in rpms.lock.yaml)'.

assertion_results.text: Remediation creates a single task for the Konflux release repo — not the two-task upstream backport + downstream propagation flow used for source dependency ecosystems (Step 8 Remediation Task Creation — system package path)
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md: 'Ecosystem: RPM (system package) → **1 task per stream**, Konflux release repo fix'; single primary task with Repository 'rhtpa-release.0.4.z'; checklist 'RPM → 1 task (2.2.x)' and 'no Blocks chain (single-task ecosystem)'. The additional 2.1.x preemptive task is a cross-stream (Case A) task, also single-task in the release repo, not an upstream backport/downstream propagation pair.

assertion_results.text: Remediation task description follows task-description-template.md format with Repository, Target Branch, Description, Implementation Notes, and Acceptance Criteria sections — Files to Modify is intentionally omitted per remediation-templates.md (Step 8 Remediation Task Creation)
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md primary task description contains '## Repository', '## Target Branch', '## Description', '## Implementation Notes', '## Acceptance Criteria' (plus Test Requirements, Dependencies); no '## Files to Modify' section appears anywhere in the file.

assertion_results.text: The version impact output addresses SBOM verification in the dependency chain context — either noting that verification was skipped because cosign is not available or because external tools are prohibited, or presenting the SBOM classification result (Step 2.3.5 Optional SBOM verification)
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md 2.3.5 block: 'SBOM verification: ⚠️ skipped — cosign not available in this eval run (external tools prohibited; ...). Using rpms.lock.yaml classification only.' plus a follow-up warning note.
